name: Rafter Larder

Traits.name: Loft-Bound
Traits.text: While the larder is not touching the ground, the larder cannot be made to descend from its span or perch and ignores effects that would bring it to the ground; it remains aloft unless it chooses otherwise.

Traits.name: Span-Anchored
Traits.text: While it is climbing or clinging to a ceiling, trestle or wooden span, the larder cannot be has the Prone condition or forcibly moved, and it can hang from the span with no hands free while making its attacks.
Traits.clause: The larder binds itself to the beams with silk-wrapped trestle legs. While it is climbing or clinging to a ceiling, tres

Traits.name: Ceiling Skitter
Traits.text: The larder ignores Difficult Terrain, and Opportunity Attacks against it are made with Disadvantage.

Actions.name: Multiattack
Actions.text: The larder makes three attacks, using Trestle Leg or Bolt-Studded Plank in any combination. It can replace one attack with a use of Haul Line.

Actions.name: Trestle Leg
Actions.text: *Melee Attack Roll:* +7, reach 5 ft. 8 (1d8 + 4) Bludgeoning damage plus 6 (1d12) Poison damage.

Actions.name: Bolt-Studded Plank
Actions.text: *Ranged Attack Roll:* +7, range 80/320 ft. 13 (2d8 + 4) Piercing damage.

Actions.name: Stone Drop (Recharge 5-6)
Actions.text: The larder hurls a cargo-stone boulder at a point it can see within 90 feet. *Dexterity Saving Throw*: DC 14, each creature in a 5-foot-radius Sphere centered on that point. *Failure:* 42 (12d6) Bludgeoning damage. If the target is Large or smaller, it has the Prone condition. *Success:* Half damage.

Actions.name: Haul Line
Actions.text: *Strength Saving Throw:* DC 14, each creature in a 30-foot Cone. *Failure:* The target is pulled up to 15 feet straight toward the larder, and its Speed is 0 until the start of the larder's next turn.
Actions.gmQuote: a scaffold spider that fights from the ceiling and never comes down

Bonus Actions.name: Fleet Agility
Bonus Actions.text: The larder takes the Dash or Disengage action.

lore: A scaffold-spider grows inside abandoned siege towers and mill-cranes, fusing its chitin to the beams it was born among, and it wants nothing but to hang its larder from the joists above the door everyone must use.

generation.userConcept: a scaffold-spider that fights from the ceiling and never comes down
